what: The rules and records build plan is behind the lead's map decision 0610, which slice 6 records: the plan still sizes the map in bytes against records.map.max-bytes (its Doubts at lines 39-41, the map finding's bytes and max at line 150, the setting at lines 171-190, laws L6 and L7 at lines 267-268) and lists slice 6's homes without the plan and guidelines skills' reference files and the build, guidelines and pr skills the slice edits (lines 285 and 287).
